unresolved.finding: The frozen rule requires a FAILED row for preparation, save and validation failures. The case directory/input is created before its STARTED row and before the case failure handler. Packet-wide pairing, counter/role validation and checks.json save can fail after all cases log COMPLETED, leaving only a FAIL receipt. Capture/review startup writes are outside that receipt handler, and source-guard failure also emits no FAILED row.
unresolved.required_correction: Record packet STARTED/FAILED independently of case charges; record case STARTED before case preparation, FAILED on case exceptions, and packet FAILED on aggregate/save/source-guard failures. Preserve frozen v3 unexecuted.
